name: io.github.BloodyReginaa/neuro-canvas-lms
title: Neuro-CanvasLMS
description: Read-only Canvas LMS for your AI: deadlines, grades, files, announcements. Runs on your Cloudflare.

connector_host.description: Your own connector's address, printed by the installer (npx -y neuro-canvas-lms)

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.setup: Each user deploys their own copy to a free Cloudflare account: run npx -y neuro-canvas-lms, then add the printed URL as a custom connector. Sign-in is OAuth; the Canvas token is pasted only into the connector's own page.
